title: Go-UT-Bench: A Fine-Tuning Dataset for LLM-Based Unit Test Generation in Go
datasets: Go-UT-Bench 5,264 code/test pairs; 10 Go repositories; train 3684/test790/val790.
models: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct LoRA, Llama-3.2-3B full tune, GPT-4o-mini judge.
license: Paper CC BY 4.0; HF dataset has no license metadata; paper claims source repos permissive, per-record terms should be checked.
input_setting: Go source file → generated test, fine-tuning on existing paired tests; judge compares with ground truth.
reproduction_grade: No code or weights; exact experiment not feasible from public artifact.
concept_hook: Public Go unit test pairs for task-specific SFT; highlights LLM judge limitations.
limitation: No runtime/compile/coverage or bug reveal metrics; single GPT-4o-mini judge; no Defects4J/BugsInPy/SWT experiment.
